image.alt: A Rhodes-Murphy office front with its red sign

body: Aubrey Rhodes Sr. founded the firm in Augusta in the early 1960s, and we’ve served the community for over 50 years. Our work on tax technology sparked the creation of TaxSlayer Pro, now used by tax professionals around the world.

At any Rhodes-Murphy office you can count on a friendly face and professional service. However complex your return, our licensed and certified enrolled agents will file it accurately and help you understand your financial health.
list: Offices in Georgia and South Carolina

items.a: Fees depend on your return. Call your nearest office for a free estimate.
We prepare your return, you sign it with your e-file PIN or Form 8453, and we send it to the IRS. Direct deposit gets your refund to you fastest.
Yes. We take part in the Federal/State e-file program for Georgia, South Carolina and most other states.

items.q: Can my fees come out of my refund?
items.a: Yes. With an Electronic Return Check or Electronic Return Deposit, all fees are deducted from your refund. Deposits are usually available in 7 to 13 days.

items.q: Is there a credit check for a Refund Advance?
items.a: Generally not, but we check with the IRS for liens on your refund, such as back taxes, past-due student loans or child support, which can reduce or rule out an advance.
